name: Bean with glossy eyes
description: An eye style (FX Spec 1.13): `"eyeStyle": "glossy"` gives Bean a dark lens, a teal iris and pupil that follow its gaze, highlights that stay with the light and a lid line. It still blinks, glances and takes every expression, because the style draws inside the same eye shape. A recipe sets its own default (`"style"` on its `eyes` part, with `iris` and `sclera`).
